card.name: Just before phone numbers and times
card.fires_on: The word 'number', 'phone', or the space or colon right before a phone number's digits. Also the start of a clock time in schedules and forum timestamps.

modes.label: Before a phone number
modes.description: The word number, phone, or the following space or colon, right before the digits of a telephone number.
modes.example: to Corza Medical GmbH, at telephone<< number>> 1-800-9

modes.label: Before a clock time
modes.description: A space or leading zero just ahead of a time in a travel schedule or forum post date.

card.writes: It promotes translation and foreign-related words, hinting at international contact or foreign-language context.
card.plain: It fires on the spot just before a phone number or a clock time begins, often in international contact details.
